Bagpipe chanter in 3D

How to use this view

Drag to turn, scroll or pinch to zoom; draw Explode to pull the strips outward and the plates apart along the chanter. Every part is the cut file’s own outline. The strips, darker, taper with the cone: wider toward the sole. The finger holes face you, high A’s on the back, and a side hole on each side near the sole; where a hole is wider than its face it is a stadium. Above the strips, the collar and the tenon with the reed’s seat; at the sole, two layers of flat strips make the foot. The buttons switch between four strips and six.
